executive_verdict.primary_failure_mode: Production email delivery, provider abuse protection and HTTPS hosting remain unconfigured. The local connected backend and cloud lifecycle passed integration checks.
executive_verdict.most_urgent_fix: Verify the Resend sender domain, configure SMTP and Auth abuse controls, and deploy/test the HTTPS BFF before enabling public signup.

scope.target_name: EGZ browser studio, same-origin backend and Supabase archive
scope.limitation: Landmark models are not LLM agents. Synthetic photos/accounts and Chromium were tested. Physical devices, production deployment, real email delivery and provider backup destruction were not verified.

findings.title: Public email and Auth abuse controls remain unconfigured
findings.mechanism: The owner has no Resend sender domain. Default SMTP limits do not support general signup; BFF rate limits do not protect direct provider Auth endpoints.
findings.root_cause: Owner-controlled domain and production provider configuration are outstanding.
findings.recommended_fix: Keep public signup disabled and email confirmation required. Verify domain, configure SMTP/template and provider CAPTCHA/rate limits, then test real delivery.

findings.title: Production web deployment is outstanding
findings.mechanism: The web BFF is local; production server environment, HTTPS origin and Auth URLs have not been deployed and tested.
findings.recommended_fix: Deploy with server-only secrets, exact HTTPS origin/Auth URLs, separate preview credentials and production smoke checks.

findings.title: Cloud authorization and lifecycle implemented
findings.mechanism: Verified server sessions derive UID; owner/admin RLS also checks expiry. Admin requires membership and aal2. Explicit consent, private Storage, atomic quotas, idempotency and scheduled Storage API cleanup implement the archive lifecycle.
findings.root_cause: The original static gallery had no account backend.
findings.recommended_fix: Maintain authorization regression checks and monitor cleanup failures, backlog, Storage use and credentials.

findings.title: Account cache isolation and logout cleanup implemented
findings.mechanism: UID-scoped IndexedDB and identity guards isolate app caches; logout, account switching and expiry clear cache/Blob URLs. Demo photos remain quarantined. Physical browser-profile access remains a local trust boundary.
findings.root_cause: The original gallery was shared within one browser profile.
findings.recommended_fix: Preserve identity guards and explain eviction, downloaded-file ownership and the separate demo mode.

findings.title: Public build uses an explicit file allowlist
findings.mechanism: Only enumerated public sources/assets enter dist; private configuration, captures and server source are excluded from static output.
findings.root_cause: Recursive copies could publish future private files regardless of Git ignore rules.
findings.recommended_fix: Maintain the allowlist and inspect deployment artifacts when adding assets.

findings.title: Browser persistence and original PNG export implemented
findings.mechanism: IndexedDB stores bounded PNG blobs. Download preserves originals while oversized cloud copies may shrink; browser eviction can still remove cache.
findings.root_cause: The original object URLs were only in memory.
findings.recommended_fix: Keep save-failure/capacity feedback and PNG download for durable local copies.

findings.title: Physical multi-device compatibility is not established
findings.mechanism: Viewport tests do not establish physical camera, printer, memory or WASM behavior across mobile devices and Safari.
findings.root_cause: Hardware and cross-engine evidence is missing.
findings.recommended_fix: Test physical Windows/macOS/Android/iOS devices before promising complete support.

ordered_fix_plan.goal: Configure verified Resend domain, SMTP/template and provider Auth abuse controls
ordered_fix_plan.expected_effect: Reliable verified public accounts with abuse controls

ordered_fix_plan.goal: Deploy and test HTTPS web BFF with exact origin/Auth URLs
ordered_fix_plan.why_now: Only the local web app is connected

ordered_fix_plan.goal: Validate physical devices and owner MFA
ordered_fix_plan.why_now: Synthetic tests do not configure personal devices

ordered_fix_plan.goal: Monitor retention failures, backlog, quotas and provider usage
